why_this_can_go_viral: Combines body horror with taboo religious practices, triggering morbid curiosity and shareability.

hook: A sun god that hated light. His worshippers lived their whole lives in underground caves.
why_this_can_go_viral: The inversion of a familiar archetype (sun = good) creates cognitive dissonance and intrigue.

why_this_can_go_viral: Time manipulation horror is a popular trope that resonates with existential dread.

why_this_can_go_viral: Moral dilemma + supernatural object = high engagement and comment bait.
